MappingPage                              baseline 03f2168, before tldraw
+-- Composition boundary
|   +-- MappingPocPage(services)
|   |   `-- MappingServicesContext -> MappingWorkspacePage
|   +-- Injected: DiagramService [G] / CanvasHistoryService [E]
|   `-- WorkspaceStorage: injected or created by page
+-- Page-retained workspace resources
|   +-- CanvasWorkspace: registry owns session lifetimes
|   |   +-- drafts[id]: metadata + stable CanvasSession handle
|   |   |   +-- name / savedName / savedScene / savedEdges
|   |   |   +-- revisionId / representationId / hidden / busy
|   |   |   `-- viewport / focusBox / reloadKey
|   |   +-- controllers: document ID -> session.controller
|   |   +-- setDrafts(seed) -> new CanvasSession
|   |   +-- replacement/removal -> unsubscribe + dispose old session
|   |   `-- exposes readable drafts / changes / dirtyScenes stores
|   +-- CanvasSession: publishes controller-owned state
|   |   +-- creates MappingDocumentController [D]
|   |   +-- document store: immutable document reference
|   |   +-- presentation store: display + diagramViews
|   |   +-- selection / controls / geometry / status stores
|   |   +-- retains saved baseline; updateBaseline uses save capture
|   |   +-- dirty = scene/edge key differences or changed name
|   |   `-- dispose: unsubscribe controller; clear commit listeners
|   +-- SourcePaneViewState: owns live scroll + cameras
|   |   +-- bind: per-pane owner token guards writes/cleanup
|   |   +-- entries keyed by document/pane; guarded by source identity
|   |   +-- captureDisplay / captureCamera sample live values
|   |   `-- prune removed panes; flush/dispose notification timers
|   +-- DiagramEditCoordinator + DiagramRevisionReceiver
|   `-- DiagramSearchService: page creates and disposes service
+-- MappingDocumentController: authoritative live document + canvas
|   +-- Snapshot: contextId / canvasRevisionId / version
|   |   `-- canUndo / canRedo / cell / endpointBounds
|   +-- MappingGridDocument
|   |   +-- scene: LineGridScene [A]
|   |   |   +-- root: GridBox hierarchy
|   |   |   `-- contents[local content ID]: Diagram [B]
|   |   +-- edges: DiagramConnection[]
|   |   +-- optional jumps: CanvasJump[]
|   |   `-- sections: content ID -> section ranges
|   +-- MappingCanvasState
|   |   +-- selection: SelectionState
|   |   |   +-- items: ordered membership; whole instance or region
|   |   |   +-- region: source ASCII/revision + rect + selectedIds
|   |   |   `-- selectionCommand enforces deduplication/exclusion
|   |   +-- diagramViews: per-instance content folding
|   |   |   `-- contentRevisionId + collapsedContentNodeIds
|   |   +-- display: DisplayState [C]
|   |   |   +-- rootIds + nodes[id]: FloatingPane
|   |   |   `-- pane childIds define presentation hierarchy
|   |   `-- controls: separate persisted control surfaces
|   |       +-- activeBoxId / selectionFocusId / activeThreadId
|   |       `-- surfaces[id]: actions, prompts, ask state, status
|   +-- changes coordinated through applyUpdate / updateCanvas
|   `-- history retained behind runtime CanvasEditingContext [E]
+-- Unified read boundary: canvasDisplayNodes(...)
|   +-- inputs: document + canvas + version + cell + endpointBounds
|   +-- grid:<boxId>: diagram or group
|   |   +-- cells: resolved bounds; childIds; expansion
|   |   `-- content / contentNodes / diagram; subtree visibility
|   +-- floating:<id>: selection / projection / conversation / detail
|   |   `-- pixels: geometry + placement + FloatingBox value
|   +-- arrows: drawEdge(edges, scene, views, cell, endpointBounds)
|   `-- returns cloned registry; geometry has no second write owner
+-- View composition
|   +-- mounted document IDs retained across tab switches
|   |   `-- active/hidden/busy flags gate document interaction
|   +-- SourcePaneDocumentContext + active-document context
|   +-- DraggableDiagramCanvas
|   |   +-- initialTransform / focusBox / active enablement
|   |   +-- onTransformChange -> viewState.setCamera
|   |   `-- MappingPocSelectionCanvas(session)
|   |       +-- transfer / undo / jump / edit callbacks
|   |       `-- project context / projection catalog / search matches
|   +-- MappingSubmenu + MappingDiagramExplorer
|   +-- ChangeSessionPreview + DiagramSearchPanel
|   `-- DiagramEditComposer(coordinator)
+-- Page coordination
|   +-- activeId / transfers / pendingTransfer / workspaceBusy
|   +-- catalog snapshot / draft aliases / selected proposal
|   +-- open(saved revision) -> document/history -> workspace seed
|   +-- save acknowledgement advances captured saved baseline
|   +-- search inputs: settled catalog + visible drafts + proposal
|   `-- agent bridge: descriptor + handleAgentCommand [D]
`-- Persistence and resource lifetime
    +-- WorkspacePersistence: translates live owners to records [E]
    |   +-- workspace commit subscriptions + view subscriptions
    |   `-- metadata / baseline / history deltas / canvas / viewport
    +-- MappingWorkspaceSnapshot: schemaVersion 3
    |   `-- projectId / activeDocumentId / documents[] / transfers[]
    +-- capture(): history + document + sampled display/camera
    +-- transfer publication: storage.save -> installWorkspace
    +-- view replacement/unmount: flush + dispose SourcePaneViewState
    `-- page cleanup: dispose edits/workspace; flush owned storage
        `-- owned WorkspaceStorage.dispose releases worker/requests
